'''Revelation There Is Good In Him Classic for ScottGaeta''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 18 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Strategy:''' There Is Good In Him
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 TIGIH Revelation LS 2003 ThereIsG.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

My own There Is Good In Him gone Classic. Don't rate.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Use Strike Planning to pull Solo and Madine, Madine to pull Chewie, Midge, and Kensaric, then play Life Debts and Rebel Leaderships to beatdown, then place their characters out of play with Out Of Commission.
